definitions.explanation: A stroke caused when a blood vessel in the brain is blocked, so that part of the brain is damaged; it can cause paralysis or difficulty speaking.

examples.japanese: ⟦{祖父|そふ}→祖父：01452_sofu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{脳梗塞|のうこうそく}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{倒|たお}れた→倒れる：01160_taoreru⟧。
examples.english: My grandfather collapsed with a stroke.

examples.japanese: {脳梗塞|のうこうそく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{後遺症|こういしょう}→後遺症：08622_kouishou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦リハビリ→リハビリ：11192_rihabiri⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{続|つづ}けて⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: He continues rehabilitation for the aftereffects of a stroke.

examples.japanese: {脳梗塞|のうこうそく}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{発症|はっしょう}して→発症する：22367_hasshousuru⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦すぐ→すぐ：00814_sugu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{治療|ちりょう}→治療：03503_chiryou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{始|はじ}めること⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{何|なに}→何：00498_nani⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧だ。
examples.english: With a stroke, starting treatment immediately after onset matters more than anything.

notes:
Japanese distinguishes the kinds of stroke: {脳梗塞|のうこうそく} (blocked vessel) and {脳出血|のうしゅっけつ} (bleeding in the brain) are both kinds of ⟦{脳卒中|のうそっちゅう}→脳卒中：04647_nousocchuu⟧ (stroke in general).

- {脳梗塞|のうこうそく}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{倒|たお}れる→倒れる：01160_taoreru⟧: to collapse with a stroke
